info.title: Nexus Webhooks
info.description: Events that Nexus sends to your HTTPS endpoint. Payloads are intentionally thin and contain identifiers only.

post.description:
An account is created.

Payloads contain identifiers only. Load the current record via the Nexus API or MCP.

id.description: Unique event ID (`evt_...`). Identical to the `webhook-id` header. Use it for deduplication.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when the event occurred.

id.description: UUID of the user or agent, if known.

channel.description: `agent` if an AI agent made the change, otherwise `system`.

id.description: UUID of the account.

200.description: Return a `2xx` status within 5 seconds to acknowledge receipt.

post.description:
A candidate moves to another stage in a project. The payload contains the new stage only, not the previous one.

Payloads contain identifiers only. Load the current record via the Nexus API or MCP.

id.description: Unique event ID (`evt_...`). Identical to the `webhook-id` header. Use it for deduplication.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when the event occurred.

id.description: UUID of the user or agent, if known.

channel.description: `agent` if an AI agent made the change, otherwise `system`.

id.description: UUID of the assignment (the candidate in the project).

new_stage_id.description: UUID of the stage the candidate moved to.

200.description: Return a `2xx` status within 5 seconds to acknowledge receipt.

post.description:
An AI agent run finishes. The event is sent once, when the run status changes to `completed`.

Payloads contain identifiers only. Load the current record via the Nexus API or MCP.

id.description: Unique event ID (`evt_...`). Identical to the `webhook-id` header. Use it for deduplication.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when the event occurred.

id.description: UUID of the user or agent, if known.

channel.description: `agent` if an AI agent made the change, otherwise `system`.

id.description: UUID of the agent run.

run_id.description: UUID of the agent run. Identical to `data.id`.

200.description: Return a `2xx` status within 5 seconds to acknowledge receipt.

post.description:
A manager clicks **Send test event** for an endpoint. Test events never affect the endpoint health.

Payloads contain identifiers only. Load the current record via the Nexus API or MCP.

id.description: Unique event ID (`evt_...`). Identical to the `webhook-id` header. Use it for deduplication.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when the event occurred.

id.description: UUID of the user who sent the test event.

channel.description: Always `ui` for test events.

endpoint_id.description: UUID of the endpoint the test event was sent to.

200.description: Return a `2xx` status within 5 seconds to acknowledge receipt.
